# corpus-pipeline

> A local document pipeline that records sources, acquires content, chunks and embeds documents, stores corpus data in SQLite, and combines full-text with vector retrieval.

## Project documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Defines the architecture, supported workflows, storage layout, and operational limits.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Contains the MIT license terms.

## Evaluation

- [eval/README.md](eval/README.md): Explains the synthetic judgments, metric definitions, and real run.
- [eval/results/2026-10-12-833796a.md](eval/results/2026-10-12-833796a.md): Records the real local-model evaluation results.
- [eval/results/2026-10-12-4117b89.md](eval/results/2026-10-12-4117b89.md): Records the OR matching rerun results.
- [eval/run_eval.py](eval/run_eval.py): Checks passages, builds a fresh index, and writes measured reports.

## Configuration and packaging

- [corpus.example.yml](corpus.example.yml): Provides example paths, local service endpoints, model settings, chunking, and search controls.
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Declares package metadata, dependencies, optional extras, and the `corpus` command.
- [banned-strings.example.txt](banned-strings.example.txt): Shows an optional content-exclusion pattern file.

## Entry points and core implementation

- [corpus_pipeline/cli.py](corpus_pipeline/cli.py): Dispatches acquisition, processing, search, chronology, refresh, health, and maintenance commands.
- [corpus_pipeline/__main__.py](corpus_pipeline/__main__.py): Runs the command-line interface as a Python module.
- [corpus_pipeline/config.py](corpus_pipeline/config.py): Loads YAML configuration and environment overrides.
- [corpus_pipeline/corpus_db.py](corpus_pipeline/corpus_db.py): Manages SQLite chunk, full-text, vector, and source-state storage.
- [corpus_pipeline/embedder.py](corpus_pipeline/embedder.py): Calls OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embedding services and checks vector dimensions.
- [corpus_pipeline/commands/process.py](corpus_pipeline/commands/process.py): Performs incremental cleaning, chunking, embedding, and index updates.
- [corpus_pipeline/commands/search.py](corpus_pipeline/commands/search.py): Runs hybrid and federated retrieval with optional expansion and reranking.

## Examples and tests

- [examples/quickstart.txt](examples/quickstart.txt): Shows an abbreviated local workflow and expected output shape.
- [examples/docs/2024-06-retrieval.md](examples/docs/2024-06-retrieval.md): Supplies synthetic retrieval content for the quickstart.
- [tests/test_search.py](tests/test_search.py): Checks search parsing, rank fusion, query construction, and caption filtering.
- [tests/test_services.py](tests/test_services.py): Marks service-dependent end-to-end coverage and its prerequisites.
